fields.Author: BojanBabic ([@bokadigimon](https://sketchfab.com/bokadigimon))
fields.Changes: A rigged, PBR-textured modern Large White (34,312 tris, 52-joint 3ds Max Biped skin, one 10 s clip). Sketchfab wrapper nodes, four unused UV sets and the tangents dropped; welded and simplified (meshoptimizer) to 14,000 tris, skin weights kept. Lower legs lengthened 6 cm at source scale (forearm/front cannon, rear gaskin/cannon) in the bind pose and re-bound, for a leggier medieval animal. Metres: withers 0.65 m before individual scale, centred, facing +z, lowest vertex over both clips at y = 0. Two clips: `Idle`, the whole source loop (looks about, sniffs the ground, looks up), and `Root`, its head-down 5.04–7.63 s (ends 2.8 cm apart; last 0.5 s blended into the frames before its start), the neck pitched up to 9.2° further where the head is low so the snout still meets the ground. Head/neck joints renamed; metalness off. 1K colour and normal maps (JPEG), 512 px occlusion/roughness; positions unquantized; meshopt, 626 KB. The pink map gives only detail: black, dark reddish-brown and belted coats are set at runtime (`src/world/animals.js`). `scripts/models/pack_pig.mjs`.
